UnitStatement: Datasheet covers deliverable DEL-07-02 Execution Root Scaffolding from Decomposition.
Deliverable ID is DEL-07-02 with name Execution Root Scaffolding from Decomposition.
DEL-07-02 belongs to Package PKG-07 (Filesystem Execution, Lifecycle, and Dependencies).
Decomposition variant is SOFTWARE_DECOMP at revision v3.2.
DEL-07-02 is of type BACKEND_FEATURE_SLICE.
Responsible Party for DEL-07-02 is TBD.
Context Envelope for DEL-07-02 is M.
DEL-07-02 covers scope items SOW-024 and SOW-025.
DEL-07-02 supports objective OBJ-006.
Primary function: scaffold SPEC-conformant execution roots from decomposition markdown idempotently and recoverably.
Runtime surface: the /api/harness/scaffold POST endpoint wraps execution-root scaffolding.
Execution root contents include INIT.md, flat package folders, and tool roots _Aggregation, _Change, _Coordination, _Decomposition, _Estimates, _Reconciliation, _Archive, _Scripts, and _Sources.
_Coordination/_COORDINATION.md is part of the execution-root layout and scaffold output.
Package layout uses flat PKG-XX_Label or PKG-XXX_Label folders with no nested package layer.
Deliverable folders are placed under {PKG-ID}_{PkgLabel}/1_Working/{DEL-ID}_{DelLabel}/.
Minimum deliverable fileset is _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _REFERENCES.md, and a _SEMANTIC.md placeholder.
Document kit files are Datasheet.md, Specification.md, Guidance.md, and Procedure.md.
PREPARATION compatibility is reported before the user proceeds.
Working-root basis: project truth lives in plain files under the working root and accepted git history.
Root separation: instruction root and working root are separate, and ordinary project execution must not mutate the instruction root.
Idempotence condition: existing directories and files are preserved on rerun.
Recovery diagnostics are fail-fast and include stage, target path, and created paths for recovery.
_STATUS.md is the canonical lifecycle state file.
docs/PRD.md is accessible but has a HASH_MISMATCH in _REFERENCES.md and is used as a warning-bearing source per the task brief.
Scaffold parser parses decomposition markdown enough to identify package rows and deliverable rows for v3.2 SOFTWARE_DECOMP; exact parser implementation is TBD.
Root initializer creates or validates INIT.md at the execution root; content schema is TBD.
Coordination initializer creates or validates _Coordination/_COORDINATION.md, aligning coordination mode values to TYPES vocabulary where applicable.
Package scaffolder creates flat package folders using {PKG-ID}_{Sanitize(PackageName)}/ plus required/expected subfolders.
Deliverable scaffolder creates deliverable folders under 1_Working/ and seeds the minimum PREPARATION fileset.
Validation summary returns validation summaries, PREPARATION compatibility, issue counts, scaffold counts, created path inventory, and fail-fast recovery diagnostics including stage and target path.
Idempotence tests should prove reruns preserve existing directories, file contents, and file metadata, and report compatibility without duplicating or corrupting files.
DEL-07-02 exists to turn accepted SOFTWARE_DECOMP markdown into a filesystem execution root that downstream Chirality workflows can inspect, validate, and continue.
The deliverable's value is preserving project truth as explicit files under the working root with stable package and deliverable identity, not folder creation alone.
Principle - Filesystem truth first: treat created files and folders under the working root as the project substrate; runtime state, chats, and SDK transcripts do not replace governed project files.
Principle - Stable identifiers over path labels: preserve package IDs and deliverable IDs even if labels or paths later change.
Principle - Flat hierarchy: keep the hierarchy as packages containing deliverables; do not add phases or nested packages inside scaffold output.
Principle - Root separation: enforce working-root containment and avoid instruction-root mutation during scaffold operations.
Principle - Idempotent recovery: preserve existing paths on rerun and make partial-failure recovery explicit via created-path inventories and stage diagnostics.
Principle - Lifecycle compatibility: seed _STATUS.md as the canonical lifecycle file so later status APIs and human gates operate on a consistent contract.
Principle - Unknowns stay visible: missing values, parser uncertainties, or source gaps should produce TBD, diagnostics, or compatibility issues rather than invented project truth.

Scaffold output is a boundary between decomposition truth and execution working state; the service should copy or reference the accepted decomposition snapshot without treating generated folders as a replacement for decomposition authority.
PREPARATION compatibility should be treated as an operator-facing readiness check, not as proof that downstream deliverables are complete.

Scaffold operation should avoid over-owning adjacent responsibilities: metadata contract validation belongs to DEL-07-03, lifecycle transition enforcement to DEL-07-04, and Dependencies.csv v3.1 behavior to DEL-07-05.
ASSUMPTION: because DEL-07-02 is a backend feature slice with multiple file outputs, tests should emphasize fixture coverage and recovery diagnostics over UI presentation.
Trade-off - strict failure vs best-effort creation: prefer fail-fast with created-path inventory, matching PRD acceptance.
Trade-off - preserve existing files vs normalize on rerun: preserve existing paths/files during scaffold rerun and report compatibility issues separately.
Trade-off - generated defaults vs source fidelity: seed required files conservatively and use TBD where source data is missing.
Trade-off - route-owned vs service-owned behavior: keep /api/harness/scaffold thin and place behavior in a reusable scaffold service.

Trade-off - broad parser vs bounded fixture support: start with the accepted v3.2 SOFTWARE_DECOMP package/deliverable table shape, then report unsupported shapes as compatibility issues until additional grammars are source-backed.
Expected root shape includes INIT.md, PKG-07_Filesystem_Execution_Lifecycle_and_Dependencies/1_Working/DEL-07-02_.../, _Coordination/_COORDINATION.md, and _Decomposition/.
On rerun, an existing package folder, deliverable folder, or metadata file should be preserved unless a separately authorized workflow owns migration or repair.
The scaffold response should report what already existed, what was newly created, and what prevents PREPARATION compatibility.
P3 disposition F-003: file-content preservation is made explicit, not only path preservation.

Declared upstream dependencies remain unresolved for DEL-07-02; treat _DEPENDENCIES.md as the current dependency evidence container and do not infer accepted upstream closure from extracted rows alone.
P3 disposition X-001: dependency-readiness posture is covered in Procedure prerequisites and reinforced as an explicit readiness posture.
No source-content conflict was identified during P1/P2 drafting; the docs/PRD.md HASH_MISMATCH is a source warning, not a semantic conflict under this task brief.
Procedure defines the operational workflow for implementing and verifying execution-root scaffolding from decomposition markdown for DEL-07-02.
Prerequisite: an accepted decomposition markdown path is available.
Prerequisite: the working root has been selected and validated.
Prerequisite: instruction root and working root are distinct.
Prerequisite: the scaffold operation target is under the active working root.
Prerequisite: required source contracts REF-001 through REF-007 are available, with the REF-006 warning noted.
Prerequisite: _DEPENDENCIES.md declares no accepted upstream edges yet; X-001 keeps this an explicit readiness blocker until accepted edges or a human ruling exist.

Step 1: confirm the active decomposition reference by verifying the operator-provided path resolves to the accepted v3.2 SOFTWARE_DECOMP working surface, and preserve decomposition-derived IDs and names in scaffold output.
Step 2: validate the target working root - confirm it is absolute, accessible, and not inside the instruction root, and reject scaffold writes outside the active working root.

Step 3: parse decomposition package and deliverable rows to extract package ID, package name, deliverable ID, deliverable name, type, description, anticipated artifacts, scope items, objectives, and context envelope where present.
Step 3: if a required value is missing, emit TBD or a typed compatibility issue rather than inventing it.
Step 3: treat the accepted v3.2 SOFTWARE_DECOMP package/deliverable table shape as the initial supported parser fixture boundary; unsupported shapes produce compatibility issues.
Step 4: ensure INIT.md and the SPEC-listed tool roots exist or are validated, and ensure _Coordination/_COORDINATION.md exists or is validated.
Step 5: create or validate package folders using {PKG-ID}_{Sanitize(PackageName)}/, create or validate required/expected subfolders especially 1_Working/, and do not create nested package layers.
Step 6: place deliverables under {PKG-ID}_{PkgLabel}/1_Working/{DEL-ID}_{DelLabel}/, seed the minimum PREPARATION fileset for new deliverables, and preserve existing directories and files on rerun.
Step 7: new deliverable _STATUS.md files should represent OPEN scaffold state, and later lifecycle transitions must not be performed as part of this scaffold slice.

Step 8: report execution root, decomposition path, package count, deliverable count, created directory/file inventory, already-existing path/file indicators, layout validation, PREPARATION compatibility, and issue count.
Step 8: on failure, report fail-fast stage, target path, and created path inventory.
Step 9: run unit tests for parser, layout creation, idempotence, fail-fast conflict handling, and path policy.
Step 9: run API route tests for POST /api/harness/scaffold.
Verification: execution-root layout - INIT.md, flat package folders, _Coordination/_COORDINATION.md, and tool roots exist (DEL-07-02-REQ-001, REQ-006).
Verification: package flatness - package folders are not nested and use PKG-XX_Label or PKG-XXX_Label structure (DEL-07-02-REQ-002).
Verification: deliverable placement - deliverables are under each package 1_Working/ folder with valid DEL prefixes (DEL-07-02-REQ-003).
Verification: minimum fileset - new deliverables include _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _REFERENCES.md, and _SEMANTIC.md (DEL-07-02-REQ-004).
Verification: status baseline - new scaffolded deliverables start at OPEN (DEL-07-02-REQ-005).
Verification: idempotence - rerun preserves existing paths/files and reports already-existing content without destructive rewrite (DEL-07-02-REQ-007).
Verification: fail-fast recovery - filesystem conflicts return stage, target path, and created paths (DEL-07-02-REQ-008).
Verification: API route - POST /api/harness/scaffold invokes scaffold behavior and returns a summary payload (DEL-07-02-REQ-009).
Verification: path policy - writes outside the active working root and instruction-root writes are rejected (DEL-07-02-REQ-011).
Verification: parser boundary - accepted v3.2 SOFTWARE_DECOMP fixtures parse and unsupported table shapes return compatibility issues (DEL-07-02-REQ-013).
Records: a warning record must note docs/PRD.md was used despite the _REFERENCES.md HASH_MISMATCH under explicit task instruction.

Specification scope: the backend feature slice scaffolds a SPEC-conformant execution root from accepted decomposition markdown for Chirality App vNext, covering SOW-024 and SOW-025 flat package/deliverable layout for PKG-07.
In scope: parse the active decomposition markdown enough to derive packages and deliverables.
In scope: create or validate INIT.md, tool roots, _Coordination/_COORDINATION.md, package folders, deliverable folders, and the minimum PREPARATION fileset.
In scope: preserve flat package topology and deliverable folder naming.
In scope: return diagnostics that support idempotent reruns and recovery after fail-fast errors.
In scope: support the /api/harness/scaffold runtime route or its backend service layer.
Out of scope: UI presentation beyond the scaffold API result surface.
Out of scope: lifecycle transition enforcement beyond seeding the scaffold baseline; status transition APIs belong to DEL-07-04.
Out of scope: Dependencies.csv parser/writer behavior beyond creating or leaving dependency placeholders; dependency register behavior belongs to DEL-07-05.
Out of scope: human assignment of ResponsibleParty, which remains TBD until assigned.
DEL-07-02-REQ-001: the scaffold operation MUST create or validate an execution root containing INIT.md, package folders, and the SPEC-listed tool roots.
DEL-07-02-REQ-002: package folders MUST be flat and named {PKG-ID}_{Sanitize(PackageName)}/, and the scaffold operation MUST NOT introduce nested packages.
DEL-07-02-REQ-003: each deliverable folder MUST be created under {PKG-ID}_{PkgLabel}/1_Working/{DEL-ID}_{DelLabel}/.
DEL-07-02-REQ-004: each newly scaffolded deliverable folder MUST include the minimum PREPARATION fileset _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _REFERENCES.md, and _SEMANTIC.md.
DEL-07-02-REQ-005: new deliverable _STATUS.md files MUST represent the OPEN scaffold state and remain canonical lifecycle inputs for later status workflows.
DEL-07-02-REQ-006: the scaffold operation MUST create or validate _Coordination/_COORDINATION.md under the execution root.

DEL-07-02-REQ-007: the scaffold operation MUST be idempotent for existing directories and files; reruns preserve existing paths and existing file contents unless a separately authorized workflow owns migration or repair.
DEL-07-02-REQ-008: failures MUST fail fast and return diagnostics including stage, target path, and created paths sufficient for recovery.
DEL-07-02-REQ-009: the scaffold route MUST expose the operation through POST /api/harness/scaffold.
DEL-07-02-REQ-010: the scaffold operation SHOULD report PREPARATION compatibility before downstream TASK work proceeds.
DEL-07-02-REQ-011: runtime tools involved in scaffolding MUST enforce working-root containment and must not mutate the instruction root during ordinary project execution.
DEL-07-02-REQ-012: unknown decomposition-derived values or unsupported parser details MUST be preserved as TBD or reported diagnostics rather than guessed.

DEL-07-02-REQ-013: the parser support boundary MUST be explicit - the first supported input is the accepted v3.2 SOFTWARE_DECOMP package/deliverable table shape, with unsupported or ambiguous shapes reported as compatibility issues instead of silently accepted.
The POST /api/harness/scaffold response shape remains an implementation contract to finalize, but tests should expect source-backed semantic fields.

Scaffold result field group - Created/existing inventory: created path inventory plus already-existing path/file indicators sufficient to verify idempotence; exact field names TBD.
Scaffold result field group - Validation summaries: layout validation and PREPARATION compatibility readiness including issue count; exact field names TBD.
Scaffold result field group - Failure diagnostics: fail-fast stage, target path, and created path inventory; exact field names TBD.
